declaration.disclosed: Known before this declaration: the masked round (configs/adsb_ctx3_mask_dev_v1.json; rule null because January's interval included zero, w40 Jan / Jul / Dec about -0.02 / -0.05 / -0.08% against v51's model part; shipped as v52 on the user's override), the two member-weight rounds (null; v52's weights stay), the thinned-coverage checks, and the official scores of v51 (222.2306) and v52 (222.0519). No official score enters this round.
declaration.export_plan: if mask32_w40 is selected (or the user overrides) and the user says so: tools/build_combo_member.py --declaration this file for the new seeds' ranking tables, the member file as a dry run on v51's member file with the 32-seed masked member at 0.40, then configs/daily_totals_v1.json applied last with tools/export_daily_totals.py --base; every upload is the user's decision.

fits.footing: January and July 2025: leave-one-month-out on the other eleven months of 2025; November: the forward fold (reported only); December: the January-November refit; ranking: the twelve-month refit. Equal to the control rows' footing (runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet) and to the combination round's.
fits.runner: tools/run_adsb_ctx_lomo.py, unchanged; jobs tools/combo_jobs.py --declaration; queue tools/combo_queue.sh

declaration.purpose: Seed extension of v52's masked member (the user: 'use gpu', 1 October 2026): 16 new seeds (717-732) of the same m25_32 network on the same five folds, so that the masked member becomes a 32-seed mean. Question: at the unchanged weights (combination 0.40, masked 0.40), does the 32-seed masked member beat v52's 16-seed one under the unchanged rule? Declared before any fit of these seeds.
declaration.rule: the clean line's unchanged rule: eligible when no equal-footing month (January, July, December) is worse on all rows than the control, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1 and every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; the lowest mean ratio among the eligible is selected; otherwise nothing
declaration.scorer: tools/run_member_weights.py (alternative_members / reported_only added before this declaration; unchanged for earlier declarations)
declaration.semantics: table_1 = (1 - c) x (0.25 e24 + 0.25 e24b + 0.5 e32) + c x combo_all on non-LIRF rows where both are finite; table_2 = (1 - m) x table_1 + m x mask_unmatched on non-LIRF rows where both are finite; v46's mix on table_2 (network share 0.85; share 0.5 where the committee sits more than 1,200 s above the table); then the whole v46 development stack (tools/run_member_weights.py). The candidate replaces mask_unmatched by the named alternative member.
